fileTrigger-selector.label: Target
fileTrigger-selector.tip: Trigger collides with target actor and triggers the "Hit Actor" event

enemy.name: Enemy
enemy.tip: Select enemy actors of the skill caster

friend.name: Friend
friend.tip: Select friendly actors of the skill caster

team.name: Team Member
team.tip: Select team members of the skill caster

team-except-self.name: Team Member Except Self
team-except-self.tip: Select team members except the skill caster

any-except-self.name: Any Except Self
any-except-self.tip: Select any actor except the skill caster

fileTrigger-onHitWalls.label: On Hit Walls
fileTrigger-onHitWalls.tip: What to do when the trigger collides with a wall

destroy.name: Destroy
destroy.tip: Destroy trigger when its anchor point enters a wall

fileTrigger-onHitActors.label: On Hit Actors
fileTrigger-onHitActors.tip: What to do when the trigger collides with an actor

destroy.name: Destroy
destroy.tip: Destroy trigger when it hits an actor

penetrate-destroy.name: Destroy After Multiple Hits
penetrate-destroy.tip: Trigger is destroyed after specified number of hits

fileTrigger-hitCount.label: Hit Count
fileTrigger-hitCount.tip: Max number of times trigger can hit actors

fileTrigger-shape-type.label: Shape
fileTrigger-shape-type.tip: Shape of trigger for collision detection

rectangle.name: Rectangle
rectangle.tip: A rectangle with specified width, height, and anchor

circle.name: Circle
circle.tip: A circle with the trigger as center and a specified radius

sector.name: Sector
sector.tip: A sector with the trigger as center and a specified radius and central angle

fileTrigger-shape-width.label: Width
fileTrigger-shape-width.tip: Horizontal length of trigger shape at 0 degrees

fileTrigger-shape-height.label: Height
fileTrigger-shape-height.tip: Vertical length of trigger shape at 0 degrees

fileTrigger-shape-anchor.label: Anchor
fileTrigger-shape-anchor.tip:
Horizontal position of the connection point between trigger and scene at 0 degrees
0 = Left
0.5 = Center
1 = Right

fileTrigger-hitMode.label: Hit Mode
fileTrigger-hitMode.tip: How often the trigger collides with an actor

once-on-overlap.name: Once On Overlap
once-on-overlap.tip:
Only hit an actor once when overlapping the trigger
Actor can be hit again after separating from the trigger

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.tip: Hit an actor multiple times; interval can be specified

fileTrigger-hitInterval.label: Hit Interval
fileTrigger-hitInterval.tip: Time between multiple hits on the same actor

fileTrigger-initialDelay.label: Initial Delay
fileTrigger-initialDelay.tip: Delay before trigger activates and can hit actors

fileTrigger-effectiveTime.label: Effective Time
fileTrigger-effectiveTime.tip:
Duration of trigger activation. When timed out, it no longer hits actors
0 = permanent activation

fileTrigger-duration.label: Duration
fileTrigger-duration.tip:
Duration of trigger existence; destroyed after timeout
0 = use trigger animation duration (destroy when animation ends)

fileTrigger-inherit.label: Inherit
fileTrigger-inherit.tip:
Inherits specified trigger's events and scripts
If the same type of event exists, it overrides the inherited trigger's event
Overridden events can still be triggered using the 'Call Event' command
However, inherited scripts will stack instead of being overridden

fileTrigger-motion.label: Motion
fileTrigger-motion.tip: Select a motion of the trigger animation

fileTrigger-priority.label: Priority
fileTrigger-priority.tip:
Sorting priority of trigger animation when rendering
Animations below always overlay those above
Priority = -1: shift sort up by one tile.
Priority = 1: shift sort down by one tile.

fileTrigger-rotatable.label: Rotatable
fileTrigger-rotatable.tip: Whether to automatically update the animation rotation angle

fileTrigger-events.label: Events
fileTrigger-events.tip:
A list of trigger events
Access "Skill Caster" to get the actor who is casting the skill
Access "Event Trigger Actor" to get the actor who is casting the skill
Access "Event Trigger Skill" to get the skill that created this trigger
$Optional types
Autorun: Triggered when the trigger appears in a scene
Hit Actor: Triggered when the trigger collides with an actor. Access "Event Trigger Actor" to get the actor who was hit
Destroy: Triggered before the trigger is destroyed (hit an actor or wall, timeout)

fileTrigger-scripts.label: Scripts
fileTrigger-scripts.tip: Add script files to extend this trigger
